Recorded conditions of live rows, grouped by directory and identical recorded conditions. Superseded rows are excluded. Loaded libraries are mappings, not proof that every mapped BLAS was called; NumPy's private scipy\_\allowbreak{}openblas library is listed separately by its path. Thread counts are runtime limits, not measurements of BLAS worker activity. CPU affinity/\allowbreak{}NUMA fields describe the recording thread; they do not establish every worker's placement. Missing fields mean not recorded.
